research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: AppZen is researching methods and systems for automatically detecting fraud and compliance issues in enterprise expense reports. By implementing a semantic analysis algorithm on expense report data submitted by employees, their work focuses on computerized approaches to identify anomalies in financial documentation. This area of research and development centers on leveraging artificial intelligence to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of financial compliance and fraud detection.

overview_description.description:
AppZen is an artificial intelligence platform for modern finance teams, helping them to reduce spending, comply with policy, and streamline processes. It automates manual processes, uncovers problems, and optimizes decision-making for enterprises around the globe, including one-fourth of the Fortune 500. The company focuses on areas such as expense report auditing, accounts payable (AP) automation, and compliance monitoring to help finance teams reduce manual work, avoid errors, and manage risk.

The platform combines patented deep learning, computer vision, and semantic analysis with intelligence from thousands of online data sources to understand financial transactions in a business context and make decisions before those transactions happen.

product.name: Mastermind Platform
product.description: An AI automation platform for finance teams that coordinates AP and travel-and-expense workflows, analytics, integrations, and configurable finance processes.

product.name: Expense Audit
product.description: An AI-powered expense auditing service that reviews expense reports, receipts, and transactions for policy violations, duplicates, fraud, and regulatory compliance before reimbursement.

product.name: Autonomous AP
product.description: An AI-based accounts payable automation service for capturing invoice data, assigning GL codes, matching purchase orders, and processing invoice approvals with reduced manual work.

product.name: AP Inbox Service Center
product.description: An AI-powered AP email management service that categorizes supplier communications, answers invoice-status questions, processes documents, detects duplicates, and routes exceptions.

product.name: Card Audit
product.description: An AI service for auditing corporate card transactions and enforcing spending policies across purchasing cards, travel cards, and other corporate card programs.

product.name: E-Invoicing
product.description: An e-invoicing service designed to help organizations manage electronic invoice requirements and comply with country-specific mandates.
